title: exists local retract opcycles of perfect tor
statement:
Let E be a derived module-sheaf object over a commutative ring sheaf R with universal Tor amplitude in [a,b], a≤b. Let P be a bounded strict-perfect representative of its restriction to U. There is a covering sieve of U on each arrow V→U of which the further restriction of opcycles(P,a) is a retract of a finite power of the rank-one free module. Sheafification, derived-category and universe assumptions are precisely those displayed below.

Precise quantified statement:
theorem exists_local_retract_opcycles_of_perfect_tor
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [∀ U : C, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [∀ U : C, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R))]
    [hDU : ∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R).over U))]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)))
    (U : C)
    (P : StrictPerfectCoefficientRepresentationOfUniverses.{u, v, 0} R U
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R) U E))
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hTor : ∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R))
        (r : ℤ), r < a ∨ b < r →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ r).obj
        ((wfSiteDerivedTensor J R).obj
          (E, (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G)))) :
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ J U ∧
      ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
        ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (Retract
          ((overMap.{max u v}
            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)
            f).obj (P.F.opcycles a))
          (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin n ↦ unit
            (((sheafCompose J
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R).over V)))

proof.text: Use the bounded flat model to restrict the Tor interval; the local equational criterion proves that flatness restricts at independent universes. Finite-free retract terms are dualizable and flat, so the bounded complex is K-flat. The first-variable tensor comparison and the degree-zero tensor isomorphism prove universal exactness in degree a-1. The categorical Tor diagram chase proves the opcycles flat. Construct a finite global presentation explicitly with matrix (1-ip, i d q), checking its cokernel universal property. Restriction preserves colimits, hence this gives local finite presentations without binary products on the site. Apply the declared flat finitely presented local-retract theorem on the slice and transport its retract along the iterated-slice equivalence. The terminal-slice covering is a covering of U.
